faqs.q: Will it email me without asking?
faqs.a: AI agents ask before sending, even to you, until you allow it in Settings. Until then each summary waits in Needs you, where you can approve it, change it or decline it.

faqs.q: Stripe already emails scheduled reports. Why use this?
faqs.a: Stripe's email is a notice with a link to a file you download. This AI agent writes the summary itself, with the totals and what moved, so you read it in your inbox.

faqs.q: What happens when a week has payments in two currencies?
faqs.a: Stripe records each amount in its own currency. Tell Captain to keep each currency apart in the email, so nothing is added across currencies.

faqs.q: Will refunds show up in the summary?
faqs.a: Not by default. The Stripe actions it reads from cover payment intents, invoices and customers, while refunds only come as events. If refunds matter, say so and Captain tells you what it can do.

faqs.q: Can I use this for my accounting?
faqs.a: No. It is a readable summary of the week. For books that reconcile to your payouts, use Stripe's scheduled reports.
